name: Nocturnal Angels
source:
With no memory of how he got there, a young man quickly discovers himself lost in the world of Surreal - a land where art is magic. In a school that suspects him of a recent kidnapping, he must master the magical arts to bring the victim home, all while navigating the allure of sculptors and seamstresses.​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/nemesis_studio/]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
一名年轻人不记得自己是如何到达那里的，他很快发现自己迷失在超现实世界中——这是一个艺术充满魔力的土地。在一所怀疑他最近发生绑架事件的学校里，他必须掌握魔法才能将受害者带回家，同时还要应对雕塑家和女裁缝的诱惑。​

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/c/nemesis_studio/]Patreon[/url]]
